subjects.body: The NCAA recognizes women's rugby as an Emerging Sport, a direct pathway toward varsity status and an NCAA championship.
More than 50 colleges already field varsity rugby under USA Rugby, proving the model works at the collegiate level.
Rugby Sevens has been an Olympic sport since 2016, and in 2024 the USA women won bronze.
The Rugby World Cup comes to the United States in 2031, putting the sport in front of its biggest American audience yet.
